decisions.reason: The two-component injection unit still had its own page through 2019 and fits the core coating and injection equipment line, so it costs little to keep while its market value is still uncertain.
It is a sibling variant of A that shares components and the sales channel, so the option is cheap to hold and nothing so far signals failure.
The automatic airless spray gun is a core consumable-type product with steady demand from industrial customers, and its continuous dedicated presentation suggests it is worth keeping.
The manual airless gun belongs to the established product range at low marginal cost, and its stable visibility on the website gives no reason to abandon it.
The air-assisted airless gun complements the spray gun family, and keeping this option open costs little while its niche demand is still unclear.

The data logger was downgraded from its own page to a mere mention in 2019, which signals weaker prospects, but digital monitoring options are cheap to hold and could gain value, so it stays for now under close watch.
